'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Brady Moore LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title LSC. Working (V) → [[Wokling (V)]]. Path Shuffle → [[The Bith Shuffle & •Desperate Reach]]. Protection → [[Projection Of A Skywalker]]. CPTA (V) → [[Captain Han Solo (V)]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brady Moore]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
